sources.title: Constant-depth adaptive preparation of Dicke and symmetric states
sources.finding: The abstract gives exact but probabilistic Dicke preparation with polynomial ancilla overhead; repetition suppresses failure rather than removing it.
sources.challenge_implication: Not an accepted deterministic circuit without an explicit treatment of all failure branches, routing and diagonal readout.

sources.title: Constant-Depth Unitary Preparation of Dicke States
sources.finding: Constant-depth results assume unbounded CZ interactions; arbitrary-weight exact clean preparation also uses quantum fan-out.
sources.challenge_implication: These are not native Willow two-qubit CZ primitives. Any comparison must decompose and route them.

sources.title: Efficient Preparation of Dicke States
sources.finding: The abstract reports adaptive global projective measurements and global rotations with polylogarithmic depth and ancillary resources.
sources.challenge_implication: Needs a finite native measurement/feed-forward circuit and branch analysis; no native-depth gain inferred from the abstract.

sources.title: Low-Depth Quantum Symmetrization
sources.finding: Result 1 has near-unit success probability and approximately logarithmic depth. Result 2 succeeds with probability one, uses O(n log n) ancillas, and has approximately log-cubed depth. Section IC2 applies these to Dicke states; the conclusion highlights restricted-connectivity sorting as open work.
sources.challenge_implication: Audit Result 2 at finite N rather than treating Result 1 as a deterministic native implementation. Count sorting/comparison workspace and routing explicitly before pursuing synthesis.
